value.rationale: The separately controllable restart rates represent a natural physical distinction (medium re-equilibration vs particle redistribution). The exact sharp threshold a=b changes whether squared-coordinate cross-memory asymptotically matches same-coordinate memory. The strict monotone ratio and surviving macroscopic spatial variance provide directly interpretable fourth-order benchmarks; this is neither a textbook constant-diffusivity reset substitution nor an arbitrary isolated coefficient.
residual_risks: The result is for a tightly defined Brownian Poisson model; significance for arbitrary fluctuating diffusivity or non-Poisson resets is not proved.
